findings.evidence: Torus/Basic.lean:130 `theorem splitTorusCommHopfAlgProperty.torus (k : Type u) [Field k] (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u,u} k) (hH : splitTorusCommHopfAlgProperty k H) : torusCommHopfAlgProperty k H`; `grep -rn "splitTorusCommHopfAlgProperty\." TauCeti` outside the new file returns only `.torus` (Basic.lean:37,130) — the new split trio has no consumer. findings.fix: Delete the three split-level theorems (and their doc bullets); split-torus users write `hH.torus.geometricallyConnected` / `.geometricallyReduced` / `.smooth`. findings.issue: `splitTorusCommHopfAlgProperty.geometricallyConnected` (line 100), `.geometricallyReduced` (line 112) and `.smooth` (line 124) are one-step compositions of the torus versions (lines 132, 148, 164) with the pre-existing `splitTorusCommHopfAlgProperty.torus`: identical binders and identical `[Field k]` hypotheses. All three are unused, including by the torus proofs in this file, and each carries a `@[grind →]` tag that duplicates the chain `.torus` + torus lemma.

summary: The torus-level results and the descent theorems are the right surface, but the three split-torus corollaries duplicate the torus trio composed with the existing `splitTorusCommHopfAlgProperty.torus`, are unused in-repo, and give `grind` a second derivation path for the same conclusions.
